newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares drop 7.27 pct on political worries.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares drop 7.27 pct on political worries.

text.p: Delhi share prices shed 7.27 percent on Monday on nervous selling by speculators, triggered by the Congress party's shock decision to withdraw support to the coalition government, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 55.93 points lower at 713.21.
The Congress party on Sunday withdrew its support to the ruling United Front coalition of Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda and staked a claim to form a new government.
On Monday President Shankar Dayal Sharma set an April 7 deadline for Deve Gowda to prove his majority in the lower house of parliament.
Bharat Bhushan Aggarwal of brokers Nu-Era Equities said shares prices would probably continue to slide until the political scenario cleared.
Brokers said selling by speculators and foreign institutional investors (FIIs) dominated a nervous market.
Reliance Industries fell 28.00 rupees, or 9.76 percent, to 258.75 on heavy selling by speculators and FIIs, brokers said.
TISCO lost 17.60 rupees, or nearly 10 percent, to 160.40 rupees, they said.
